notes.content: The Social Work program is designed for students to begin in the Fall semester. Students must earn a "B" grade or higher in all pre-major requirements and must earn at least a 2.5 GPA to declare the major. The Pre-Major is a total of 12 units: 3 units from GE Area 5B, 3 units from GE Area 4 (Part A), 3 units from GE Area 4 (Part B), and SWRK 95. Beginning Fall 2023, the Bachelor of Arts in Social Work will require a "B" or higher in SWRK 95. Students are strongly advised to complete all undergraduate General Education units before beginning upper-division major coursework. For additional information, please visit the Division of Social Work .
